aboutLuke: Producer and songwriter sharing sketches, demos, and works-in-progress — built for collaborators, artists, and A&R who want to hear the ideas behind the records.
intro: Browse demos in the library. Pick a piece to read notes and press play.

tracks.title: Care
tracks.subtitle: Boogie Type Beat
tracks.about: A warm, bounce-heavy sketch built for vocal hooks. Written as a reference for collaborators — drums sit back enough for a lead to breathe.

tracks.title: Her Place
tracks.subtitle: Soulful Instrumental
tracks.about: Muted keys and a slow groove — meant to feel like a room with the lights low. Good for showing melodic writing without a full mix.

tracks.title: Midnight Run
tracks.subtitle: Synthwave Sketch
tracks.about: Pulsing bass and arpeggios — a work-in-progress cue for film or game pitches. Structure is loop-ready for A&R listens.

tracks.title: Open Road
tracks.subtitle: Acoustic Demo
tracks.about: Fingerpicked guitar and a simple motif — shows songwriting before production. Recorded live in one take for honesty.

tracks.title: Pressure
tracks.subtitle: Trap Instrumental
tracks.about: Hard-hitting drums and a minimal motif — built for artists who want space up top. Mix is intentionally dry for clarity.
